name: Rust
postCreateCommand: curl https://www.influxdata.com/d/install_influxdb3.sh | bash && sudo cp .devcontainer/influxdb3 /etc/init.d/influxdb3 && sudo chmod +x /etc/init.d/influxdb3 && sudo service influxdb3 start && (sudo service grafana-server start || true) && curl -L https://github.com/questdb/questdb/releases/download/9.3.5/questdb-9.3.5-rt-linux-x86-64.tar.gz  | tar -xz && ./questdb-9.3.5-rt-linux-x86-64/bin/questdb.sh start
